I5.quote: Chromium-based metal-organic framework (MOF), MIL-101(Cr), has emerged as a potential hydrogen storage material because of its high specific surface area, tuneable pore size, and unique structure.

notes: The AC@MIL-101 composites contain only 0.63-2.5 wt% carbon (main, p. 3, Section 2.4), so they are MOF-majority and not carbon sorbents under section 3. Eligibility rests on the pure activated carbon sample (Chemviron WS-480): H2 isotherm at 77.4 K to 6000 kPa measured in this paper (Figure 6), 3.7 wt% at the highest pressure and BET 946.96 m2/g (Table I). The paper does not use the word volumetric or gravimetric for the H2 measurement; the instrument is named as an automated high-pressure gas adsorption system (BELSORP-HP), and I1 is judged met because the paper reports its own measured H2 isotherms from the gas phase. SI covers HKUST-1 (a MOF, not carbon). Not retracted: record.json is_retracted is false and no retraction text found in main or SI. Original research article; no statement that all H2 uptake values were published before.
